milestone: Stage 2 — visual guidance and address checks
next: Stage 3 — website trust and download protection, after independent Stage 2 testing

features.name: Visual task assistant
features.implementation: implemented for the two supported public workflows
features.live_integration: English Wikipedia Phishing → APA and VideoLAN → Windows information page; local intent rules, no external model.
features.feature_verification: Builder: both routes completed at both desktop sizes in Chrome on stage-2-490d7abfc3ce. Independent Stage 2 acceptance not run.
features.acceptance: A user states a supported goal and follows accurate, sequential highlights across the task, including a settings-navigation example.

features.name: Website address verification
features.implementation: implemented locally for the current page, proposed guide link and selected inspectable controls
features.live_integration: Actual current and suggested hosts observed on both public sites. Platform URL parser and bundled tldts 7.4.19; no external reputation integration.
features.feature_verification: Builder: live sites, native address fixtures, stale-link and parser boundaries verified on stage-2-490d7abfc3ce. Independent Stage 2 acceptance not run.
features.acceptance: Expected domains, lookalikes and misleading subdomains produce appropriate findings based on the actual URL.

features.name: Website trust popup
features.acceptance: A supported website displays a trust summary using local findings and available external evidence, with sources and an explicit missing-data state.

features.name: Download button protection
features.acceptance: The extension compares inspectable destinations on a supported download page, explains a misleading button, and highlights the intended route.

features.name: Seller reputation checks
features.acceptance: A supported seller page yields an evidence-linked summary of seller feedback, history and other listings, with identity and coverage clear.

features.name: Product review checks
features.acceptance: A supported product page yields a summary of product-specific reviews and recurring concerns, separated from seller findings.

features.name: Automatic task navigation
features.acceptance: A user-approved supported navigation task runs in the existing session, with progress, pause and cancel, stopping for any consequential final action.

features.name: Hide distracting ads and popups
features.acceptance: A toggle hides identified distractions on a supported page and a restore action returns them without breaking essential controls.

features.name: Compare better products and sellers
features.acceptance: Available comparable options display observed prices, seller and product evidence, reasons for comparison and usable source links.
